authoritative.label: NASA/JPL Horizons API
notes: Credential-free NASA/JPL Horizons API using DE441 apparent geocentric observer ecliptic-of-date longitudes.
Verifies Sun through Pluto, Moon, Chiron, direct/retrograde by finite difference, and aspects among supported bodies.
Does not verify mean node, Lilith, Asc/Desc/MC/IC, house cusps, retrograde stations, shadow boundaries, or transit exact-hit bisection in the current adapter.

Use a locally downloaded PDF path via TLDR_ASTROCOM_SWISS_EPHEMERIS_2026_PDF before treating this as an ingested oracle.

secondarySanity.label: Cafe Astrology 2026 Ephemeris
notes: Cafe Astrology describes the tables as daily tropical longitudes at midnight Eastern Time.
Cafe Astrology notes March 2026 and November 2026 PDF timezone caveats around DST.
This source can sanity-check daily sign/degree/station tables but does not verify arbitrary-location houses, angles, or topocentric/geocentric configuration.
